text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for Auxilium prod - embed_latency_p95 > 1200ms for 3m (route: tenant-embed-checks)

maria (oncall): saw the page, jumping in. checking dashboards...

maria (oncall): embed_latency_p95 spiked to ~1.6s for tenant=auxilium in us-west-2, traffic burst at 15:23 UTC

kevin: noticed similar on our internal staging earlier today. could be a KV cache miss pattern after deploy?

maria (oncall): no deploy in last 6h for hosting infra, but model variants switched to v2-highmem yesterday.

ops-automation: auto-action: rate-limit-throttle applied to route tenant-embed-checks (20% global reduction) by playbook embed-throttle-20

maria (oncall): thanks bot. can we mute paging while we investigate? it's paging all night for Auxilium which is low-sev but chatty.

kevin: +1 on muting, but let's ensure we capture full traces first. can you enable debug sampling for tenant auxilium for 10m?

maria (oncall): enabling debug sampling now: `rbx debug-sample --tenant auxilium --duration 10m --rate 1:100`

maria (oncall): also opened a lightweight incident in notes: INC-AUX-2027, tagging infra and embeddings.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-AUX-2027 by maria (oncall) — channel #eng-oncall — severity: P2 — link: https://redwood.inc/INC-AUX-2027

tara: FYI Auxilium reported minor UI slowness in support thread, they said it started around 15:20 UTC.

kevin: looking at KV hit rate: auxilium prefix hit drops from 98% -> 61% at 15:22. prefix cache eviction spike.

maria (oncall): that would explain extra work per request. any memory pressure OOMs on cache nodes?

kevin: no OOMs reported. but see elevated evictions on node pool embed-cache-1. Pod restarts around that time: `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep embed-cache` shows 2 restarts on embed-cache-1a

maria (oncall): restarting cache pod now to see if it stabilizes. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-cache -n infra`

ops-automation: action logged: cache pod restart initiated by maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): after restart latency p95 down to ~900ms, errors steady. paging still suppressed for 15m (mute).

kevin: can we reduce sensitivity for that specific check? current alert: `embed_latency_p95 > 1000ms for 3m` firing on per-tenant basis. For high-variance tenants like auxilium I'd prefer `>1200ms for 5m` + require >50 req/s to avoid spike noise.

tara: agreed. Auxilium has known traffic bursts from nightly jobs. making it threshold + volume guard makes sense.

maria (oncall): propose patch to alert rule:
```
alert: TenantEmbedLatencyHigh
expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_request_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant=~".+"}[5m])) by (le, tenant))) > 1.2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
  mitigator: autoscale+cache
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/tenant-embed-latency
```

kevin: also add a guard: `and sum(rate(embed_requests_total{tenant="$tenant"}[5m])) > 50` so tiny tenants don't trigger.

maria (oncall): I'll open a PR to alerts repo and link to this thread. PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/842 (WIP)

incident-bot: Reminder: please add post-incident action items to INC-AUX-2027 before closing.

maria (oncall): followups: 1) land alert rule change (PR 842) 2) add tenant-specific dashboard panel to auxilium tile (embed latency + prefix hit) 3) investigate why cache pod restarted (oom or k8s node flapping) 4) consider soft-debounce (squelch) for repeated identical pages from same tenant within 30m

kevin: on 3) it's likely ephemeral node preemption; I'll dig into cloud provider events and node metrics.

tara: for 2) can we add a tiny dashboard panel that shows `embed_prefix_hit_ratio{tenant="auxilium"}` and `embed_latency_p95{tenant="auxilium"}` side-by-side? I'll take that.

maria (oncall): assigning tasks in the incident: @kevin — debug node events, @tara — dashboard panel, @maria — PR for alert rule + postmortem notes.

ops-automation: handoff: maria (oncall) -> kevin at 16:00 UTC. oncall rotation update applied.

kevin: taking over active investigation. leaving mute in place for 30m. please @mention me if anything else pops.

maria (oncall): thanks, Kevin. I will add the debug traces to the incident ticket and close the loop once PR is merged. :thumbsup: 

sre-bot: post-incident checklist created for INC-AUX-2027: root cause hypothesis template pre-filled.

kevin: quick note for postmortem: consider adding a global autoscaler signal if cache eviction rate > 10% for 5m to preemptively scale cache pool.

tara: dashboard panel ready — https://grafana.redwood/d/auxilium/embed-summary?panelId=7 — added volume guard visual.

kevin: got cloud events: node preempted due to scheduled maintenance at 15:18 UTC for node i-0abcd. correlates with pod restart. filing cloud ticket.

maria (oncall): PR merged (alerts/pull/842) — changed alert to p95>1.2s for 5m + reqs>50; mute removed.

incident-bot: INC-AUX-2027 marked resolved by kevin — resolution: cache pod restart after node preemption; alert sensitivity adjusted; dashboard added.

maria (oncall): closing thread, will write short postmortem with recommended autoscale + debounce rules. thanks all. :party:
